title: qa-reasoning-engine-workflow-router
_notes: E2E QA for rorca-reasoning-engine and rorca-workflow-router. Verifies DB tables, API endpoints, resolver logic, frontend components, and type safety. Agents find real bugs and fix them. No browser navigation — code-level verification only.

userStories.title: Type check — zero errors on both frontend and backend after merge
userStories.description: Run `npx tsc --noEmit` in the root directory (frontend) and `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit` (backend). Both must produce zero errors. If any type errors exist from the reasoning-engine or workflow-router merge, fix them. Common issues: missing imports for ReasoningCapability, EffortLevel, WorkflowConfig types; mismatched function signatures in llm-client.ts after reasoning mapping was added; missing properties on ModelOption interface after supportsReasoning/effortLevels were added.
acceptanceCriteria: npx tsc --noEmit in root/ exits with code 0 (zero frontend type errors)
npx tsc --noEmit in backend/ exits with code 0 (zero backend type errors)
No import errors for ReasoningCapability, EffortLevel, ResolvedWorkflowConfig, or WorkflowConfig types
All files touched by RE-001 through RE-018 and WR-001 through WR-018 compile cleanly

suggestedSkills.name: reality-validation
suggestedSkills.reason: Verify actual compilation output matches expected zero errors

userStories.title: DB migration — workflow_configs table exists with correct schema and seed data
userStories.description: Connect to the PostgreSQL database and verify the workflow_configs table created by WR-001. Run: `SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_name='workflow_configs' ORDER BY ordinal_position`. Verify columns: id (uuid), workflow_id (text, NOT NULL, UNIQUE), runtime (text, NOT NULL), provider (text, NOT NULL), model (text, nullable), updated_at (timestamptz). Then verify seed data: `SELECT workflow_id, runtime, provider, model FROM workflow_configs ORDER BY workflow_id`. Expected 3 rows: memory_consolidation, pipeline_execution, spec_generation. Verify CHECK constraints exist for workflow_id and runtime columns. If the table is missing, run the migration manually or check pg-migrations/ for the file.
acceptanceCriteria: workflow_configs table exists in the rorca schema
Table has columns: id (uuid), workflow_id (text NOT NULL UNIQUE), runtime (text NOT NULL), provider (text NOT NULL), model (text nullable), updated_at (timestamptz)
Three seed rows exist: spec_generation, pipeline_execution, memory_consolidation
CHECK constraint on workflow_id allows only the 3 valid workflow IDs
CHECK constraint on runtime allows only 'native', 'claude', 'opencode', 'codex'

suggestedSkills.name: reality-validation
suggestedSkills.reason: Verify actual DB schema matches spec

userStories.title: DB migration — reasoning_tokens column exists in token_usage table

If the column doesn't exist, find the migration file in backend/src/db/pg-migrations/ and run it, or create one if missing. The column should be INTEGER with a default of 0.
acceptanceCriteria: token_usage table has a reasoning_tokens column of type integer
Column has a default value of 0
Migration file exists in backend/src/db/pg-migrations/ with timestamp prefix format

userStories.title: API — GET /api/workflow-router returns 3 rows with correct shape
userStories.description: Start the backend server if not running. Call GET /api/workflow-router using curl or the test suite. Verify the response is a JSON array of 3 objects, each with fields: workflowId, runtime, provider, model, hasApiKey (boolean), updatedAt. Verify the 3 workflowIds are 'spec_generation', 'pipeline_execution', 'memory_consolidation'. If the endpoint returns 404, check server.ts for the route mount. If it returns 500, read workflow-router.ts for the error. Fix any issues found.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/workflow-router returns 200 with a JSON array
Array contains exactly 3 objects
Each object has fields: workflowId (string), runtime (string), provider (string), model (string|null), hasApiKey (boolean), updatedAt (string)
workflowIds are 'spec_generation', 'pipeline_execution', 'memory_consolidation'

Then test validation: PUT /api/workflow-router/spec_generation with { runtime: 'opencode' } should return 422 (spec_generation must be 'native'). PUT /api/workflow-router/invalid_workflow with any body should return 422. Fix any validation gaps.

userStories.title: Backend integration — pipeline trigger uses resolveWorkflowConfig not raw env vars
userStories.description: Read backend/src/routes/pipeline.ts and verify the POST /api/pipeline/trigger handler calls resolveWorkflowConfig('pipeline_execution') instead of directly reading RORCA_AGENT or RORCA_MODEL env vars. The resolved config's runtime should be used as the agent type, and wfConfig.model should be in the model resolution chain. Verify the spec-level model override still takes priority: request body model > specJson.model > wfConfig.model. Check that wfConfig.apiKey is injected into the subprocess env. If the old env var path is still in use, replace it with the workflow config resolver.
acceptanceCriteria: pipeline.ts trigger handler calls resolveWorkflowConfig('pipeline_execution')

userStories.title: Backend integration — chatComplete handles reasoning params for all 3 providers
userStories.description: Read backend/src/lib/llm-client.ts and verify chatComplete() translates ChatOptions.reasoning into each provider's native format. For Anthropic: reasoning.enabled=true → thinking: { type: 'enabled', budget_tokens } in the API request. For OpenAI: reasoning.effort → reasoning_effort parameter. For OpenRouter: reasoning → { reasoning: { effort } }. Verify the hardcoded GLM-5 reasoning block has been removed (RE-004). Write or run a test that mocks each provider and asserts the correct native param shape. Fix any issues.
acceptanceCriteria: chatComplete() maps reasoning.enabled=true to Anthropic thinking block with budget_tokens
chatComplete() maps reasoning.effort to OpenAI reasoning_effort parameter

userStories.title: Backend integration — graceful degradation retries without reasoning on provider error
userStories.description: Read the graceful degradation logic in llm-client.ts (RE-015). Verify: (1) chatComplete() catches provider errors containing 'reasoning' or 'thinking' in the error message and retries without reasoning params. (2) On retry success, a structured warning is logged. (3) An in-memory Map override cache is updated with supportsReasoning: false. (4) Subsequent calls skip reasoning without retrying. Run or write a Jest test that mocks a provider to throw on first call with reasoning and asserts retry behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: chatComplete() catches reasoning-related provider errors and retries without reasoning params
